none; display: inline !important;"><font style="color: rgb(26, 26, 26);"><b style="">Home Activity</b><br>HomeActivity is the main dashboard where users land after login. It features bottom navigation (Home, Published Ads, Status, History) and a side drawer (Profile, Help, About, Logout). The smart Floating Action Button (FAB) automatically enables/disables based on whether users have published ads. Real-time notifications alert users when their screen gets rented, and the navigation header updates dynamically with profile info.</font></span></font><br></span>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="126" y="-616" width="371" height="243" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ybPwG3hFW9xY9lZHGrwI-68" value="<br><span style="font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &quot;Open Sans&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; float: none; display: inline !important;"><font style="color: rgb(26, 26, 26);"><font style="font-size: 19px;"><b style="background-color: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));">Home Fragment</b><br></font><span style="font-size: 16px;">HomeFragment displays device Android ID, location, and all created slots as interactive cards. Users can publish slots to the public marketplace, which moves them from private to public collections while keeping backups. Delete and update options allow full slot management.</span></font></span>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="-246" y="-498" width="277" height="232" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ybPwG3hFW9xY9lZHGrwI-70" value="<span style="font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &quot;Open Sans&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; text-align: start;"><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><b style="">PublishedAdsActivity</b><br>Shows all user's published ads in the marketplace. Users can delete ads, which removes them from both public and private collections. Displays publish dates and slot details.</font></span>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="-550" y="35" width="233" height="164" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ybPwG3hFW9xY9lZHGrwI-71" value="<span style="background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212));"><font style="font-size: 19px;"><b>Update slot info activty<br></b></font></span><p style="margin: 16px 0px; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &quot;Open Sans&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;" class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">This activity provides smart forms for creating/editing slots. text-align: start;"><font style="font-size: 19px;">The BootReceiver listens for boot completion intents and launches a transparent BootStartActivity. This activity provides the necessary user context to start the ScreenSaverService as a foreground service, which is required for Android 12+ compatibility where foreground services cannot be initiated directly from broadcast receivers.</font></span></font>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;textShadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1550" y="-221" width="354" height="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-15" value="<p style="margin: 16px 0px; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &quot;Open Sans&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif;" class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><font style="font-size: 21px;"><b style="">Inactivity Detection</b><br></font><font style="font-size: 18px;">A TouchDetectionService creates a transparent overlay that covers the screen. Touch events trigger ACTION_OUTSIDE detection, notifying the ScreenSaverService to reset the inactivity timer. The service continuously monitors elapsed time using SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() since the last user interaction.</font></font></p><div><br></div>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;textShadow=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="2132" y="-259" width="317" height="259" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-16" value="" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;rounded=0;elbow=vertical;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;exitX=0.367;exitY=0.01;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;exitPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ybPwG3hFW9xY9lZHGrwI-34" target="ybPwG3hFW9xY9lZHGrwI-39"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1018" y="12" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="972.0000000000009" y="201.5" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ybPwG3hFW9xY9lZHGrwI-39" value="" style="html=1;points=[[0,0,0,0,5],[0,1,0,0,-5],[1,0,0,0,5],[1,1,0,0,-5]];perimeter=orthogonalPerimeter;outlineConnect=0;targetShapes=umlLifeline;portConstraint=eastwest;newEdgeStyle={"curved":0,"rounded":0};direction=south;fillColor=#4D4D4D;rounded=1;glass=1;shadow=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="981" y="35" width="80" height="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-41" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;flowAnimation=1;shadow=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-18" target="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-32"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-18" value="<font style="font-size: 22px;"><b style="">Live Content Scheduling</b></font><div><font style=""><p style="margin: 16px 0px; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &quot;Open Sans&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, sans-serif; text-align: start;" class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-size: 20px;">A Handler runs every second to verify if the current time matches any configured timestamp intervals. Timestamps stored as minute values get compared against the current time using Calendar instances. Special logic handles timestamp intervals that cross hour boundaries.</font></p><div style="font-size: 16px;"><br></div></font></div>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1662" y="323" width="375" height="256" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-40" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;flowAnimation=1;shadow=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-21"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="2302.0001898871524" y="507.7779269748262" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-21" value="<font style="font-size: 18px;"><b style="">Subscription Management</b></font><div><font style=""><div style=""><span style="font-size: 15px;">The system parses subscription dates from TXT configuration files using SimpleDateFormat with specific patterns. Current date validation against subscription periods determines content accessibility. Expired subscriptions trigger automatic data clearance from SharedPreferences.</span></div><div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold;"><br></div></font></div>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;textShadow=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1789" y="725" width="287" height="201" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-39" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;shadow=1;flowAnimation=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-22"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="2494.5" y="666.0001085069443" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-22" value="<b><font style="font-size: 17px;">Configuration File handeling</font></b><div><span style="font-size: 17px;"><b><br></b></span><div><font style=""><div style=""><span style="font-size: 17px;">DocumentFile API scans user-selected folders for the latest TXT files. Encrypted files undergo Base64 decoding followed by AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding decryption. Regular expressions extract configuration fields including Content URLs, Running Time, and Timestamps from file contents.</span></div><div style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold;"><br></div></font></div></div>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="2345" y="763" width="299" height="241" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-38" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;flowAnimation=1;shadow=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-23" target="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-32"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-23" value="<font style=""><font style="font-size: 22px;"><b style="">App Blocking Feature</b></font></font><div><font style=""><font style="font-size: 22px;"><b><br></b></font><div style=""><span style="font-size: 19px;">UsageStatsManager identifies foreground applications by package name. Comparison against predefined camera and video application packages determines blocking decisions. Detected blocked applications trigger immediate live content termination and inactivity timer resets.</span></div><div style="font-size: 19px; font-weight: bold;"><br></div></font></div>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="2836" y="793" width="360" height="270" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-35" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;flowAnimation=1;shadow=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-24" target="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-32"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-24" value="<font style="font-size: 20px;"><b>Play Back Tracking</b></font><div><font style="font-size: 17px;"><br></font></div><div><font style=""><div style=""><font style="font-size: 17px;">AtomicLong ensures thread-safe playback duration calculations. Start and stop timestamps capture playback sessions. SharedPreferences stores hourly data with hour-specific keys. Hour transitions trigger efficiency calculations and Firebase Firestore uploads.</font></div><div style="font-weight: bold;"><br></div></font></div>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;textShadow=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="3314" y="-336" width="362" height="219" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-46" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;flowAnimation=1;shadow=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-26"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="2478.000081380208" y="31.333360460069343" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-26" value="<font style=""><b><span style="font-size: 21px;">Video Playback</span><br></b><br><div style=""><font style="font-size: 19px;">ExoPlayer handles video rendering through TextureView components. Device orientation management applies 180-degree rotations to video surfaces. ConnectivityManager verifies internet availability before initiating playback attempts.</font></div><div style="font-size: 21px;"><br></div></font>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;shadow=1;textShadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1964" y="-616" width="336" height="229" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-37" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;shadow=1;flowAnimation=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-27" target="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-32"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="3164.2222764756943" y="585.9999728732637" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-27" value="<font style=""><b style="font-size: 24px;">Forground Service Management</b><br><br><div style=""><font style="font-size: 20px;">ScreenSaverService operates as a foreground service with persistent notifications. The START_STICKY flag enables automatic system restarts. onTaskRemoved() methods implement self-restart mechanisms when users remove the app from recent applications.</font></div><div style="font-weight: bold;"><br></div></font>" style="shape=module;align=left;spacingLeft=20;align=center;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;textShadow=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="3269" y="454" width="326" height="322" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-36" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;flowAnimation=1;shadow=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-28" target="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-32"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6J24foUcmHJLAGSVX6jj-28" value="<font style=""><b style="font-size: 27px;">Image Slideshow</b><br><br><div style=""><font style="font-size: 22px;">Handler and Runnable combinations manage slide transitions based on configured durations. SharedPreferences stores image path collections. BitmapFactory.decodeFile() loads images with corruption error handling. span.font:
Home Activity
HomeActivity is the main dashboard where users land after login. It features bottom navigation (Home, Published Ads, Status, History) and a side drawer (Profile, Help, About, Logout). The smart Floating Action Button (FAB) automatically enables/disables based on whether users have published ads. Real-time notifications alert users when their screen gets rented, and the navigation header updates dynamically with profile info.

PublishedAdsActivity
Shows all user's published ads in the marketplace. Users can delete ads, which removes them from both public and private collections. Displays publish dates and slot details.

span.font: This activity provides smart forms for creating/editing slots. It automatically calculates end dates from start month + duration, checks for booking conflicts before saving, and suggests previously used features. The "Always" option disables if bookings exist.
span.span: or HomeActivity FAB (creating), returns to HomeFragment after saving.

font.font:
Download schedule worker
Background worker that runs every 15 minutes. Compares Firestore and local file timestamps, downloads updates as encrypted .enc files (falls back to .txt if encryption fails). Uses SAF for storage.

font.span: Triggered by WorkManager, coordinates with StatusFragment, uses same encryption as manual downloads.

span.font: The BootReceiver listens for boot completion intents and launches a transparent BootStartActivity. This activity provides the necessary user context to start the ScreenSaverService as a foreground service, which is required for Android 12+ compatibility where foreground services cannot be initiated directly from broadcast receivers.

font.font: A TouchDetectionService creates a transparent overlay that covers the screen. Touch events trigger ACTION_OUTSIDE detection, notifying the ScreenSaverService to reset the inactivity timer. The service continuously monitors elapsed time using SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() since the last user interaction.
